title: The edit window for a Part Library entry is titled Edit Library Part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EDITTITLE-01) exists, made by creating an inventory part with that number at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Read the dialog title.
  6. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The window that the pencil opens is titled "Edit Library Part", not "Edit Catalog Part".
  • Step 6: The dialog closes without changes.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S12-R3, S11-R3, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 12). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R3: “The dialog for editing a Part Library entry is titled "Edit Library Part".”
  • S11-R3: “Clicking a row opens that entry's detail page. The pencil beside the entry's name opens the "Edit Library Part" window, where the entry is edited and where its Delete button sits, bottom left. The detail page itself has no Delete button.”
